title: Warlocks #4 Aircel Comics 1989 Vampire Woman Painted Cover Warlock 5 Spinoff
conditionDescription: Covers clean and glossy with no creases or tears; spine and staples intact. Light handling wear. See photos.
descriptionText:
Warlocks #4 (1989), Aircel Comics - the Warlock 5 spinoff series, with a painted vampire woman cover. Original $1.95 cover price ($2.50 in Canada).

Back cover: Battle Armor role-playing game ad.

See photos for condition. Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
